key_highlights: ASX closed the week firmer driven by major bank gains following the US Federal Reserve rate pause.
Macroeconomic crosscurrents intensify as RBA hawkishness collides with severe household cash flow constraints.
Coles suffers heavy market cap loss after conceding grocery market share to Woolworths, while broader discretionary retail slumps.
Sydney residential property prices drop 10% in 237 days alongside Australia's weakest auction market conditions since 2020.
Heightened sovereign and domestic policy risks emerge around federal/Victorian fiscal debt and potential domestic gas intervention.

sectors.trend: Major banks rallied lifting the ASX 200, but mortgage growth faces headwinds from accelerating property downturns.
sectors.implications: Elevated RBA cash rates support bank margins near term, but asset quality and credit growth risks are escalating.

sectors.trend: Market share erosion hits Coles while discretionary retailers face intense spending compression from RBA rate pressure.
sectors.implications: Capital rotating from Coles into Woolworths; discretionary retailers face persistent multiple contraction.

sectors.trend: Policy intervention risk rises over domestic gas reservation alongside ongoing delivery challenges at Snowy Hydro 2.0.
sectors.implications: Regulatory uncertainty clouds domestic gas contracts, though global oil stalemate provides baseline earnings support.

sectors.trend: Exploration momentum continues in junior gold and lithium microcaps amidst steady global commodity pricing.
sectors.implications: Speculative capital favours high-grade junior drillers while large-cap iron ore miners track Chinese demand indicators.

sectors.trend: Severe downturn in residential auction markets and metropolitan home prices creates structural headwinds.
sectors.implications: Residential developers face margin squeezes and slower settlement rates; debt financing costs pressure valuations.

key_themes: Monetary vs Fiscal Friction: Reluctance to cut budget spending exacerbates RBA inflation battle.
Housing Wealth Erosion: Rapid residential real estate declines weigh on consumer sentiment and bank balance sheets.
Supermarket Competitive Repositioning: Woolworths taking market share from Coles resetting valuation parity.
Sovereign & Macro Hedging: Investors stepping up trades in bond duration insurance and AUD risk management.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight residential property developers and limit exposure to high-LVR retail banking portfolios.
Maintain allocations to floating-rate notes, defensive yield assets, and cash equivalents.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Federal Domestic Gas Market Regulatory Intervention
risk_assessment.mitigation: Prioritise energy producers with diversified international LNG contracts over pure domestic gas plays.
Favor Commonwealth Australian Government Bonds (ACGBs) over Victorian semi-government debt.

opportunities.recommendation: Long Woolworths vs Short Coles Pair Trade
opportunities.rationale: Exploit widening operational divergence and grocery market share capture by Woolworths over Coles.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Global Energy Producers on Domestic Policy Weakness
opportunities.rationale: Global supply stalemates in Iran support hydrocarbon pricing irrespective of Australian domestic gas caps.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical Exposure to High-Grade Junior Gold Explorers
opportunities.rationale: Strong assay results and drill hits driving momentum in junior exploration plays amid macro uncertainty.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce Exposure to Consumer Discretionary and Gaming
defensive_moves.rationale: Household cash flows are severely squeezed by RBA rates and home price slumps, dampening discretionary turnover.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Implement AUD/USD Downside Protection and Bond Insurance
defensive_moves.rationale: Domestic property weakness and US dollar strength warrant hedging against Australian dollar downside.

market_outlook.short_term: Rangebound ASX 200 trading between 8,100 and 8,350 as bank earnings strength offsets acute consumer and housing weakness.
market_outlook.long_term: Index trajectory depends on the RBA pivot timetable, fiscal discipline in upcoming budget updates, and stabilization in residential real estate.
